title: VOICES OF CIVILIZATIONS: A MULTILINGUAL QA BENCHMARK FOR GLOBAL MUSIC UNDERSTANDING

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating audio LLMs' accuracy on a multilingual music QA benchmark (Voices of Civilizations) to identify performance gaps between globally dominant musical traditions and underrepresented regional or traditional repertoires across 38 cultures.
Comparing model performance (accuracy) on music understanding tasks across 38 languages, specifically analyzing the disparity between high-resource languages and low-resource languages.
